info.title: ROS OCP Backend API
info.description:
GO Echo API for Resource Optimization OCP Backend Service.

**Plugin system:** Endpoints are served by plugins that can be individually enabled or disabled via `ROS_ENABLED_PLUGINS` / `ROS_DISABLED_PLUGINS` environment variables. Disabled plugin routes return `404 Not Found`. Available plugins: `container`, `namespace`, `gpu`, `node`, `pvc`, `quota`, `snapshot`, `kruize`. Default: all native plugins enabled, kruize disabled. See docs/architecture/plugin-architecture.md for details.

**Term configuration:** Recommendation terms (short/medium/long) control the lookback window for each plugin. Terms can be customized per-tenant via PUT /settings/terms. Administrators can lock terms via environment variables (`ROS_TERMS_<PLUGIN>_<TERM>_WINDOW_DAYS`, `ROS_TERMS_<PLUGIN>_<TERM>_MIN_DATA_DAYS`, `ROS_TERMS_<PLUGIN>_<TERM>_DECAY_HALFLIFE_HOURS`). Locked terms cannot be modified by tenants (PUT returns 422). Maximum window_days varies by plugin: 90 for container/namespace/node/gpu, 365 for pvc.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description:
Used as a fallback when the 'Accept' header is missing or specifies an unsupported media type.  
Maximum number of records is 1000 i.e. 6000 rows for CSV downloads.  
The 'offset' parameter can be used for pagination with both formats.

parameters.description: Partial match on cluster alias, exact match on cluster UUID

parameters.description: Exclude cluster by alias or UUID

parameters.description: Exact match on cluster alias or UUID

parameters.description: Exact match on workload type. Options are daemonset, deployment, deploymentconfig, replicaset, replicationcontroller, statefulset

parameters.name: exclude[workload_type]
parameters.description: Exclude by workload type. Must be one of: daemonset, deployment, deploymentconfig, replicaset, replicationcontroller, statefulset

parameters.name: filter[exact:workload_type]
parameters.description: Exact match on workload type. Must be one of: daemonset, deployment, deploymentconfig, replicaset, replicationcontroller, statefulset

parameters.name: true-units
parameters.description: Shows all values in true/real-world units. Accepts 1, t, T, TRUE, true, True, 0, f, F, FALSE, false, False.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of results per page (1-1000, default 100). 0 is treated as default.

parameters.name: order_by
parameters.description: Field to order results by. Options: cluster, project, workload_type, workload, container, last_reported, cpu_request_current, memory_request_current, and per-term variation fields (e.g. cpu_variation_short_cost, memory_variation_long_performance). Variation values are percent of current CPU or memory request (float); see the recommendations.variation amounts in each list item.

parameters.name: has_gpu
parameters.description: Filter by GPU presence. 'true' or '1' returns only containers with GPU data; 'false' or '0' returns only containers without GPU data.

parameters.name: gpu_model
parameters.description: Filter by GPU model name (case-insensitive substring match, e.g. 'A100', 'T4'). Repeatable for OR logic.

parameters.name: gpu_classification
parameters.description: Filter by GPU workload classification (case-insensitive substring match). Repeatable for OR logic. Values: idle, underutilized, compute_bound_underutil, memory_bound, well_utilized, no_profiling.

parameters.name: stale
parameters.description: Filter by staleness state. A recommendation is 'stale' when no new usage data has been received within the staleness threshold (default 72 hours). Values: 'false' (default, exclude stale), 'true' (include all), 'only' (show only stale recommendations).

parameters.name: filter[tag:environment]
parameters.description: Filter by OpenShift label tag (requires ROS_TAGS_ENABLED=true). Use filter[tag:<key>]=value1,value2 (OR within key; AND across keys). Legacy ?tag=key:value is also accepted. Tag key present only: filter[tag:<key>]=*

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Legacy tag filter syntax: key:value or key:* (repeatable). Prefer filter[tag:<key>]=value when ROS_TAGS_ENABLED=true.

parameters.name: filter[idle_state]
parameters.description: Comma-separated idle states to include: active, idle, zombie. Example: zombie,idle

get.description: Returns the current recommendation term configuration for the caller's org and recommendation type. Resolves precedence: admin env var > tenant DB override > plugin default. Terms marked `locked: true` cannot be modified via the API.

parameters.description: The recommendation plugin to get terms for. Use GET /settings/capabilities to list valid values.

put.description: Replace the recommendation term configuration for the caller's org and recommendation type. Maximum window_days varies by plugin (90 for container/namespace/node/gpu, 365 for pvc). If min_data_days is omitted, it is auto-computed as half of window_days. Terms locked by administrator environment variables cannot be modified (returns 422).

400.description: Validation error (invalid name, window_days out of range, min_data_days > window_days, etc.)

403.description: Tenant settings globally locked (ROS_SETTINGS_LOCKED for recommendation_type or terms) or RBAC denied

422.description: One or more terms are locked by administrator environment variables and cannot be modified

delete.summary: Reset recommendation term settings to defaults

Each node appears once with shared classification/metrics and nested `recommendation_terms.<term>.recommendation_engines.{cost,performance}` (mirrors container recommendations). get.description: Returns aggregated estimated monthly savings across all clusters for the authenticated organization. Sums persisted savings from container, node, PVC, snapshot, and VM recommendations at medium term. Container, node, and VM totals honor the optional `engine` query parameter (default `cost`). GPU savings are computed at API read time and are excluded (see `gpu_savings_note`).

parameters.name: engine
parameters.description: Recommendation engine profile for container, node, and VM savings aggregation. Defaults to `cost` for backwards compatibility.

parameters.name: group_by[tag:environment]
parameters.description: When `ROS_TAGS_ENABLED=true`, group container savings by the given tag key (value is ignored, e.g. `*`). Flat form: `group_by=tag:environment`. Returns `FleetSavingsByTagResponse` instead of the default fleet summary shape. Ignored when tag filtering is disabled.

parameters.name: group_by[idle_state]
parameters.description: Group fleet waste by idle_state (value is ignored, e.g. `*`). Returns FleetSavingsByIdleStateResponse instead of the default fleet summary shape.

get.description: Returns per-namespace Kubernetes ResourceQuota right-sizing recommendations for the authenticated organization. Compares configured quota hard limits and observed usage against aggregated container recommendation totals, then classifies each namespace as tighten (reduce over-provisioned quota), raise (usage approaching limits), or optimal. Default sort order is namespace ascending. Use `group_by[cluster]` or `group_by[project]` (not together) for aggregated rows with summed capacity freed and savings.

Recommendations.description: Container recommendation detail (DetailResponse). Used in both list and detail endpoints.

id.description: Deterministic UUID v5 derived from cluster_uuid/project/workload/container

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for monetary fields (from Koku cost model). Defaults to USD.

gpu.description: GPU recommendations keyed by GPU model name. Present only for containers with attached GPU resources.

idle_state.description: Workload activity classification. Always present; defaults to active.

peak_cpu_millicores.description: Peak CPU usage (millicores) over observation window.

peak_memory_bytes.description: Peak memory usage (bytes) over observation window.

estimated_monthly_waste.description: Full terminate opportunity when idle_state is idle or zombie.

idle_recommendation.description: Terminate guidance when idle_state is idle or zombie.

NamespaceDetailResponse.description: Namespace recommendation detail. Mirrors Recommendations (container) but without container, workload, workload_type, and gpu fields.

id.description: Deterministic UUID v5 derived from cluster_uuid/project

DetailRecommendations.description: Wraps term-level recommendations with monitoring_end_time, current resource config, replicas, savings estimate, and notifications.

estimated_monthly_savings.description: Estimated total monthly savings across all resource types (CPU, memory)

monitoring_end_time.description: End of the monitoring window used for this recommendation

notifications.description: Top-level notifications aggregated from all terms and engines. Keys are string notification codes.

ResourceConfig.description: CPU and memory resource configuration (used for current config, recommended config, and variation).

ResourceValue.description: A single resource value with amount and format.

amount.description: Resource amount. For config: cores (CPU) or MiB (memory). For variation: percentage change.

format.description: Unit format: 'cores' for CPU config, 'MiB' for memory config, 'percentage' for variation.

ReplicaInfo.description: Pod replica counts for the workload backing this container.

avg.description: Average replica count over the observation window

desired.description: Current desired replica count (from Deployment spec). Omitted if unavailable.

available.description: Current available replica count. Omitted if unavailable.

source.description: Source of replica data (e.g. 'kube_state_metrics'). Omitted if unavailable.

NotificationEntry.description: A notification associated with a recommendation.

message.example: Less than 4 days of data available for this workload

TermRecommendation.description: Recommendation data for a single term (short_term=24h, medium_term=168h, long_term=360h).

duration_in_hours.description: Duration of the analysis window in hours

notifications.description: Term-level notifications aggregated from cost and performance engines.

recommendation_engines.description: Cost-optimized and performance-optimized recommendations for this term.

EngineRecommendation.description: A single engine's (cost or performance) recommendation in the Kruize-compatible nested shape.

variation.description: Percentage change from current to recommended. Format is 'percentage' for both CPU and memory.

notifications.description: Engine-level notifications. Keys are string notification codes.

NativePlot.description: Boxplot data for a term's analysis window. Only present in the detail endpoint response.

datapoints.description: Number of time buckets in the plots_data map

plots_data.description: Map of ISO 8601 timestamp → boxplot data for that time bucket.

PlotsBucket.description: CPU and memory boxplot data for a single time bucket.

BoxPlotDetails.description: Five-number summary (boxplot) for a resource metric in a time bucket.

error.description: Human-readable reason settings writes are blocked
error.example: settings are locked by platform administrator

locked.description: Always true for global settings lock denials

cpu_adaptive_margin_enabled.description: When true, the cost engine uses CV-based CPU margin between cpu_margin_min and cpu_margin_max

history_retention_days.description: Read-only. Days of vm_recommendation_history retained (admin env ROS_VM_REC_HISTORY_RETENTION_DAYS; default 90).

locked_fields.description: Fields locked by env vars or ROS_SETTINGS_LOCKED (["*"] when globally locked)

settings_locked.description: True when ROS_SETTINGS_LOCKED prevents tenant VM settings writes

VMSettingsUpdate.description: Partial VM settings update. Any subset of thresholds, memory_floors, disk, io, network, gpu, placement, power_schedule, network_qos, storage_tiering, instance_type_matching, cpu_adaptive_margin_enabled, stability.

settings_locked.description: True when ROS_SETTINGS_LOCKED blocks VM term overrides (same lock key as /settings/vm)

recommendation_type.description: The plugin these terms apply to

settings_locked.description: True when ROS_SETTINGS_LOCKED (or per-type lock) prevents tenant Settings API writes for this recommendation type

window_days.description: Maximum varies by plugin: 90 for container/namespace/node/gpu, 365 for pvc

min_data_days.description: Minimum days of data required. Auto-computed as half of window_days if not explicitly set.

decay_halflife_hours.description: Exponential decay half-life in hours for weighted analysis. 0 means no decay (equal weighting).

is_default.description: True if this term uses the plugin default (no tenant or admin override)

locked.description: True if this term is locked by administrator environment variable and cannot be modified via PUT

window_days.description: Maximum varies by plugin: 90 for container/namespace/node/gpu, 365 for pvc

min_data_days.description: Optional. If omitted, auto-computed as half of window_days (minimum 1). Must be <= window_days.

decay_halflife_hours.description: Optional. Exponential decay half-life in hours. 0 means no decay.

business_hours.description: Whether business-hours settings and dual-stream recommendations are enabled (ROS_BUSINESS_HOURS_ENABLED)

off_hours_weight.description: Weight applied to off-hours samples (0 excludes off-hours from BH digest)

enabled.description: When false, BH digests are pruned and only all-hours recommendations are produced

reship_status.description: Historical re-ingestion status for this scope

reship_status_since.description: When the current reship_status was set

settings_locked.description: True when ROS_SETTINGS_LOCKED prevents tenant business-hours overrides

locked_fields.description: Fields frozen by ROS_SETTINGS_LOCKED (["*"] when all tenant overrides are ignored)

enabled.description: Whether the plugin is currently enabled

supports_terms.description: Whether the plugin supports configurable recommendation terms

GPURecommendation.description: GPU-specific recommendation data. Present only for containers with attached GPU resources.

current_gpu_profile.description: Current MIG profile name, or null for full GPU

gpu_classification.description: Utilization classification based on DCGM profiling metrics. Returns 'no_profiling' when profiling data is unavailable (Tier 2 GPUs).

recommended_gpu_profile.description: Recommended MIG profile, 'full_gpu', or null if no change recommended

memory_bound_detected.description: True when DRAM bandwidth is saturated but tensor cores are underutilized

gpu_confidence.description: Confidence score (0.0-1.0) for the GPU recommendation

tensor_pipe_active_avg.description: Average tensor core utilization (0.0-1.0) across observation window

dram_active_avg.description: Average DRAM bandwidth utilization (0.0-1.0) across observation window

sm_active_avg.description: Average streaming multiprocessor activity (0.0-1.0) across observation window

fb_usage_max_mib.description: Peak frame buffer usage in MiB across observation window

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for GPU savings fields (from Koku cost model). Defaults to USD.

time_slicing_node.description: Node name where GPU time-slicing is recommended. Present only for containers that are time-slicing candidates (notification code 36).

time_slicing_replicas.description: Recommended nvidia.com/gpu.replicas value (2-8) for the target node. Present only for containers that are time-slicing candidates (notification code 36).

warnings.description: Optional warnings about degraded data quality (e.g., GPU enrichment failures, scan errors)

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for savings fields (from Koku cost model). Defaults to USD.

count.description: Total number of matching results (before pagination)

total_gpus_analyzed.description: Distinct (cluster, node, GPU model) triples in gpu_container_digests for visible clusters

clusters_with_gpu_data.description: Distinct clusters with at least one gpu_container_digests row

link.description: Relative URL path to the strategy listing endpoint

warnings.description: Optional hints when tag filters yield no results or sync/catalog issues are detected
Optional hints when tag filters yield no results or sync/catalog issues are detected

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for savings fields (from Koku cost model). Defaults to USD.

SavingsObject.description: Structured monthly savings amount with six-decimal string value and ISO currency units.

value.description: Savings amount as a decimal string with six fractional digits

units.description: ISO currency code from the cost model

FleetSavingsSummaryResponse.description: Aggregated estimated monthly savings across all clusters for the organization.

FleetSavingsByTagResponse.description: Container savings grouped by a single tag key (GET savings-summary with group_by[tag:key]).

count.description: Number of distinct tag values (including null for workloads without the key)

tag_value.description: Tag value from org_container_keys.resolved_tags; null when the key is absent

vm.description: Sum of persisted VM recommendation savings_amount at medium_term for the selected engine (requires ROS_SAVINGS_ESTIMATES_ENABLED and Koku effective_rates at ingestion).

FleetSummaryResponse.description: Aggregate statistics across all container recommendations for the organization.

total_containers.description: Total number of containers with recommendations (including stale)

active_containers.description: Number of containers with non-stale recommendations

idle_containers.description: Number of containers flagged as idle (CPU < 10mc AND memory < 10 MiB)

abandoned_containers.description: Number of containers flagged as abandoned (zero CPU AND zero memory usage)

cluster_count.description: Number of distinct clusters with recommendations

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for savings fields (from Koku cost model). Defaults to USD.

usage_bytes_max.description: Maximum observed usage in bytes across all days

usage_ratio.description: Ratio of max usage to capacity (0.0 to 1.0)

recommendation_type.description: Classification: oversized (<20% used), near_full (>85% used), orphaned (0 usage), healthy (normal)

recommended_bytes.description: Recommended PVC size in bytes (null for healthy/orphaned)

days_to_full.description: Projected days until PVC reaches capacity based on growth trend (null if no growth or insufficient data)

growth_bytes_per_day.description: Estimated daily growth in bytes (from linear regression on average usage)

data_days.description: Number of days of data available for this PVC

resize_note.description: Operational guidance for acting on the recommendation (e.g., Kubernetes does not support in-place PVC shrinking)

PVCRecommendationListResponse.description: Paginated list of PVC right-sizing recommendations.

count.description: Number of results in this page

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for savings fields (from Koku cost model). Defaults to USD.

warnings.description: Optional hints when tag filters yield no results or sync/catalog issues are detected

QuotaResourceValues.description: CPU and memory quota values (hard, used, or recommended).

QuotaUtilizationPercents.description: Utilization of quota hard limits as percentages (derived from basis points in storage).

QuotaCapacityFreed.description: Capacity that could be reclaimed by tightening quota (CPU millicores and memory bytes).

QuotaRecommendation.description: Per-namespace quota recommendation row, or aggregated group row when group_by is used.

estimated_savings.description: Estimated monthly savings from tightening quota (tighten recommendations)

last_observed_at.description: Timestamp of the latest observation used for this recommendation (RFC3339 UTC)

count.description: Number of namespace rows in this group (present only when group_by[cluster] or group_by[project] is used)

QuotaRecommendationListResponse.description: Paginated list of namespace ResourceQuota recommendations.

count.description: Total matching rows (or distinct groups when group_by is used)

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for estimated_savings (from Koku cost model). Defaults to USD.

headroom_percent.description: Extra margin on recommended hard limits (10 → multiply container rec sums by 1.10)

high_risk_threshold_percent.description: Raise recommendation and high risk when max utilization reaches this percent of hard

medium_risk_threshold_percent.description: Medium risk when utilization is at or above this percent and below high_risk_threshold_percent

locked_fields.description: Fields locked by ROS_QUOTA_* environment variables or ROS_SETTINGS_LOCKED (["*"] when globally locked)

settings_locked.description: True when ROS_SETTINGS_LOCKED prevents tenant quota settings writes

locked_fields.description: Fields locked by ROS_CLUSTER_QUOTA_* environment variables or ROS_SETTINGS_LOCKED (["*"] when globally locked)

settings_locked.description: True when ROS_SETTINGS_LOCKED prevents tenant cluster-quota settings writes

validation_errors.description: Present on validation failures (e.g. settings PUT)

is_network_bound.description: True when sustained network metrics qualify for n1 network-optimized instance type

is_redundant_placement.description: True when peer VMs with the same namespace resource profile run on the same node

has_shared_storage.description: True when correlated workload peers share a namespace resource profile (PVC-level correlation requires operator PVC columns)

numa_oversized.description: True when recommended memory exceeds ROS_VM_NUMA_NODE_MEMORY_GIB (per-NUMA cap until host topology is ingested)

is_power_off_candidate.description: True when the VM is idle on most observed days but still shows occasional activity (periodically idle)

power_off_idle_pct.description: Percent of observed days classified as idle when is_power_off_candidate is true

pattern.description: Disk I/O pattern: sequential, random, mixed, low-io, or empty when unclassified

gpu_timeslice_confidence.description: Confidence in vGPU time-slicing recommendation (empty when not applicable)

recommended_vgpu_profile.description: Recommended vGPU profile when time-slicing or profile selection applies

gpu_devices.description: Populated on detail responses with per-device digest metrics

notifications.description: Structured notification objects (idle, GPU, disk, etc.)

savings.description: Estimated monthly savings from rightsizing. Null when ROS_SAVINGS_ESTIMATES_ENABLED is false, Koku masu is not configured, or no cost-model rates exist for the cluster.

sequential_threshold_bytes.description: Average I/O size (BPS/IOPS) at or above this value classifies as sequential (default 65536)

random_threshold_bytes.description: Average I/O size below this value classifies as random (default 16384)

min_iops_for_classification.description: Peak combined IOPS below this returns low-io (default 100)

throughput_threshold_bps.description: Sustained aggregate rx+tx P95 above this (bytes/sec) contributes to network-bound classification

pps_threshold.description: Packets-per-second P95 threshold for alternate network-bound path

drop_ratio_bp.description: Max daily drop ratio must exceed this (basis points; 10 = 0.1%) with high PPS

sustained_days.description: Days in term window meeting throughput or PPS+drop criteria

enable_network_series.description: When true, network-bound VMs may receive n1 instance types

VMPowerScheduleSettings.description: Power-off scheduling detection for periodically idle VMs (notification 64)

enabled.description: When true, detect VMs that are idle on most days but still show occasional activity

min_idle_days.description: Minimum days of digest history required (default 14)

idle_ratio_threshold.description: Fraction of observed days that must be idle to qualify (default 0.7)

VMNetworkQoSSettings.description: Simplified network QoS hints for network-bound VMs (notifications 65–66). Full NIC-type recommendations are future work.

enabled.description: When true, emit SR-IOV and DPDK hint notifications for network-bound VMs

sriov_drop_threshold.description: Packet drop ratio (0–1) at or above which to suggest SR-IOV (default 0.01)

sriov_throughput_bps.description: Throughput in bits/sec at or above which to suggest SR-IOV even without drops (default 5000000000)

dpdk_pps_threshold.description: Packets per second at or above which to suggest DPDK for small-packet workloads (default 500000)

VMStorageTieringSettings.description: Simplified storage tier hints from multi-day I/O patterns (notifications 67–69). Full StorageClass-aware tiering is future work.

enabled.description: When true, emit cold/IOPS/throughput storage tier hint notifications

min_days.description: Minimum digest history required before evaluation (default 7)

cold_min_days.description: Days classified as low-io to suggest lower-cost storage (default 14)

iops_min_days.description: Days with random high IOPS to suggest IOPS-optimized storage (default 7)

throughput_min_days.description: Days with sequential high throughput to suggest throughput-optimized storage (default 7)

high_iops_threshold.description: Peak daily read+write IOPS above which random I/O counts as high (default 5000)

high_throughput_bps.description: Peak daily read+write throughput (bps) above which sequential I/O counts as high (default 104857600)

VMPlacementSettings.description: Cluster placement, correlated workload, and NUMA sizing checks (notifications 60–63)

enable_placement_checks.description: When true, detect same-node redundancy and uneven node distribution

placement_skew_ratio.description: Max:min VM count per node in a profile group before notification 61 (default 3)

enable_shared_pvc_correlation.description: When true, flag correlated namespace peers (true PVC mapping requires operator PVC column)

numa_node_memory_gib.description: Assumed per-NUMA-node memory cap until host topology is ingested (default 64)

numa_assumed_sockets.description: Divides node allocatable memory from daily_node_digests for per-NUMA estimate when host topology is not ingested (default 2)

VMGPUSettings.description: GPU classification thresholds and vGPU time-slicing tunables for VM recommendations

idle_threshold_bp.description: Average SM utilization below this (basis points) classifies the GPU as idle (500 = 5%)

underutil_threshold_bp.description: Average SM utilization below this (basis points) classifies the GPU as underutilized (3000 = 30%)

fb_saturation_mib.description: Frame-buffer usage MiB above which the GPU is saturated; 0 uses 90% of catalog GPU memory

compute_saturation_threshold_bp.description: Average SM utilization at or above this (basis points) classifies compute saturation (8500 = 85%)

gpu_timeslice_min_replicas.description: Minimum recommended_time_slice_count when time-slicing is advised

gpu_timeslice_max_replicas.description: Upper cap on slice count; reduced when DRAM exceeds penalty threshold

gpu_timeslice_fb_safety_threshold_bp.description: Do not recommend time-slicing when frame-buffer fraction is at or above this (8000 = 80%)

gpu_timeslice_dram_penalty_threshold_bp.description: When DRAM is at or above this, max replicas is halved (5000 = 50%)
